description: This Java class, CohortEditor, extends a generic property editor to serialize and deserialize Cohort objects by ID and UUID, facilitating data transfer through forms or other media within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: CohortEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between string representations and Cohort objects, supporting ID and UUID retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort object by its integer ID using the CohortService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort object by its UUID using the CohortService.
